test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

P. The average adult gets two to four colds a year, while the average child may get six to eight.

Q. It is the most frequent infectious disease in humans.

R. They occur more commonly during the winter.

S. The common cold, also known simply as the cold, is a viral infectious disease of the upper respiratory tract that primarily affects the nose.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct order for the sentences is indeed** SQPR.**
 
• The first sentence **(S) introduces the topic,**
